## License field

`BSD License`

The label links to https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tfc-caelum/license. It is
CurseForge's generic BSD option: it names no clause variant and contains no license text by
itself, so it neither confirms nor resolves the `BSD 3` / `BSD-2-Clause` disagreement between the
release JAR and the Modrinth listing.
